calculations.interpretation: This is a calculated ratio of the issuer-reported September 7 allocation and issuance balance. It is not a reserve audit or independently verified asset valuation.

reconciled_interpretation: JPYSC is issued by SBI Shinsei Trust Bank; SBI VC Trade acts as issuance commissioner and distribution/operator; Startale supports technical development. These roles are distinct.
The September 7 JPY 1B short-term JGB allocation was about 4.98% of the reported JPY 20.1B issuance balance. The statutory 50% limit is a ceiling, not evidence that SBI allocated 50%.
The September 7 JPY 6.9B figure is described as lending applications. Do not relabel it as funded or outstanding lending balance.
The November 2 release reports lending balance above JPY 10B and handled balance above JPY 30B; handled balance explicitly combines on-chain balance and lending balance.
The June 24 launch was limited to VCTRADE accounts with external wallet withdrawals disabled. The November 2 release still describes public-chain conversion as a future step after legal amendments.
SBI Ripple Asia's February 26 XRPL tokenized-deposit PoC is a separate conceptual project. It does not prove that JPYSC is issued, circulated or settled on XRPL.

The reserve JGB allocation and JPYSC lending are relevant to SBI's yen stablecoin reserve management and institutional capital strategy, but they are not evidence of XRP purchases, XRP collateral usage, XRP liquidity or an XRP bridge-asset role.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: SBI is building a multi-rail digital-finance strategy in which JPYSC, RLUSD/USDC distribution and separate XRPL initiatives may eventually interoperate.
supporting_evidence: SBI distribution of RLUSD and USDC in separate disclosures
SBI Ripple Asia's separate XRPL tokenized-deposit PoC
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: November 2 still described public-chain conversion as future
The XRPL PoC does not identify JPYSC
No production JPYSC-to-XRP bridge or XRP purchase is established

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: JPYSC growth can occur without increasing XRP demand because its initial issuance, lending and reserve management are account-based and yen-denominated.
supporting_evidence: JPYSC trust reserve invested in short-term JGBs
JPYSC lending/handled-balance metrics are not XRP metrics
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: SBI separately researches XRPL tokenized-deposit infrastructure
Future public-chain and cross-stablecoin use cases remain possible but unimplemented in the cited releases

model_admission.reason: Issuer-reported JPYSC reserve and lending figures are SBI yen-stablecoin events. No causal XRP flow, public XRPL issuance, XRP purchase or XRP collateral utilization is established.
